exposure: location of mass (right vs. left of midline)
cohort: Patients diagnosed with endometriosis after a cesarean section who were operated on between January 2012 and December 2018 at the study clinic.
finding: There were no significant differences in age, previous cesarean section numbers, time to diagnosis, or endometriosis size between patients with masses on the right versus left side of the midline; most cases were detected after the first cesarean section, around 14.9 months post-procedure.
mod_finding: The majority of endometriosis cases were detected after the first cesarean section, on average 14.9 months later.
